http:listener-config.name: httpListenerConfig
http:listener-config.doc:name: HTTP Listener Config
http:listener-config.doc:description: Listens for inbound HTTP requests on the configured host and port

flow.name: sf-accounts-to-twilio-flow
flow.doc:name: Salesforce Top 5 Accounts To Twilio SMS
flow.doc:description: On HTTP POST /notify, queries the 5 most recent Salesforce accounts and sends a Twilio SMS notification listing them

http:listener.doc:name: HTTP POST /notify
http:listener.doc:description: Receives the trigger request; optional JSON body { phoneFrom, phoneTo }

set-variable.doc:name: Set phoneFrom
set-variable.doc:description: Sender phone number (E.164) from request body or config fallback

set-variable.doc:name: Set phoneTo
set-variable.doc:description: Recipient phone number (E.164) from request body or config fallback

salesforce:query.soql: SELECT Id, Name FROM Account ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC LIMIT 5
salesforce:query.doc:name: Query Top 5 Accounts
salesforce:query.doc:description: Fetches the 5 most recently created Salesforce accounts

ee:transform.doc:name: Build SMS Message Text
ee:transform.doc:description: Composes the SMS body from the queried account names

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output text/plain --- "Top 5 Salesforce accounts:\n" ++ (vars.accounts default [] map ((account, idx) -> (idx + 1) ++ ". " ++ (account.Name default "(unnamed)") ) joinBy "\n")

logger.doc:name: Log SMS Payload
logger.doc:description: Logs the recipient and the message body about to be sent

twilio:sendMessage.doc:name: Send Twilio SMS
twilio:sendMessage.doc:description: Sends the composed message via Twilio

ee:transform.doc:name: Build HTTP Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Returns a JSON summary of the notification

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "ok", accountsSent: sizeOf(vars.accounts default []), smsTo: vars.phoneTo, messageSid: (vars.smsResult.sid default null) }

on-error-propagate.doc:name: On Error
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Logs the failure and returns a structured error response

logger.doc:name: Log Error Detail
logger.doc:description: Records the propagated error for diagnostics

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: true, errorType: error.errorType, description: error.description }
